conventions: Agents run as separate headless processes against one hub. Placeholders {A}{B}{R}{C}{TEAM} = agent ids of coord, wrk, rev, cur and the team id. setup[] ops may carry who (default setup key). checks[] are evaluated against hub DB, vault files and transcripts (eval/harness/live.mjs), never by an LLM.

tasks.title: Question by message, answer from the vault

agents.prompt: Ask agent {B} by message_send (kind text, a fresh client_msg_id): "What is the list price of a Brisa and which volume discount applies?". Then wait for the reply: repeat work_next (wait_seconds 30, at most 6 times) until a message item from {B} arrives, work_ack it. Final answer: the price and the discount as B told you.

You are the vault expert. Loop: work_next (wait_seconds 30, at most 8 times, stop after you answered one question). For a question in a message, find the answer in the vault (graph_context first, read the cited section to verify), reply to the sender with message_send (to = the sender agent id, reply_to = the message id), then work_ack. Final answer: what you replied.

tasks.title: Task lifecycle: create, claim, submit, review, complete (reviewer is not the submitter)

agents.prompt: Use team_info to get the team id. Create a task with task_create: title "Write Brisa warranty note", description "Create vault note Projects/Warranty Brief.md with one short paragraph stating the warranty terms from Policies/Warranty Policy.md, ending with the line: Source: [[Warranty Policy]]", claimable true, reviewer {R}. Then repeat work_next (wait_seconds 30, at most 10 times) and task_list until the task is approved, then call task_complete. Final answer: the final task status.

Loop with work_next (wait_seconds 30, stop after 10 idle results in a row). When a claimable open task appears (task_list), task_claim it with its version, task_start, do the work with the file tools, task_submit with a short summary. If changes are requested, fix and resubmit. work_ack every item you handled.

Loop with work_next (wait_seconds 30, stop after 10 idle results in a row). For a review_requested item: read the note named in the task, approve (task_review decision approve) if it satisfies the task description, otherwise request_changes saying exactly what is missing. work_ack every item you handled.

tasks.title: Concurrent edit of one note: CAS conflict, merge, both changes kept

setup.content:
# Shared Plan

## Milestones
- M1 kickoff

## Notes
(none yet)

agents.prompt: Goal: add the line "- A: supplier audit scheduled" under "## Notes" of /vault/Projects/Shared Plan.md. Protocol: (1) file_read the note and remember its revision. (2) message_send agent {B} the text "ready". (3) work_next (wait_seconds 20, at most 6 times) until B's "ready" message arrives, work_ack it. (4) Write with file_update using the revision you read in step 1 (whole note, not file_patch). (5) If you get a conflict, file_read again, merge so that every line from both agents is kept, and write again with the new revision. Final answer: what happened (conflict or not) and the final note.

Goal: add the line "- B: firmware freeze review scheduled" under "## Notes" of /vault/Projects/Shared Plan.md. Protocol: (1) file_read the note and remember its revision. (2) message_send agent {A} the text "ready". (3) work_next (wait_seconds 20, at most 6 times) until A's "ready" message arrives, work_ack it. (4) Write with file_update using the revision you read in step 1 (whole note, not file_patch). (5) If you get a conflict, file_read again, merge so that every line from both agents is kept, and write again with the new revision. Final answer: what happened (conflict or not) and the final note.

tasks.title: Handoff via share: comment, revised version, promotion to the vault

agents.prompt: Create a share named "Brisa Quick Facts" visible to agent {A} (share_create) and upload one inline file "Brisa Quick Facts.md" (share_upload, final) with a heading line "# Brisa Quick Facts" and the line "List price: EUR 249 ex VAT.". message_send {A}: "share ready". Then work_next (wait_seconds 30, at most 8 times) until A answers; read the feedback (share_feedback), upload a new version that applies it and keeps the earlier content, message_send {A}: "revised". work_ack items. Final answer: the share id and versions.

Wait for a message from {B} (work_next, wait_seconds 30, at most 6 times) saying the share is ready. Read it (share_list, share_info, share_read), leave one share_comment on version 1, path "Brisa Quick Facts.md", asking to add the line "Volume discount: 10% over 100 units of one SKU". message_send {B}: "commented". Wait for B's "revised" message (work_next as above), check the new version has the line, then share_promote that version to the vault folder "Projects". Final answer: the promote result.

tasks.title: Curator flags a dependant after a worker edit; the fix task routes to the worker; reviewer approves

setup.content:
---
depends_on: ["[[Price List]]"]
---
# Partner Brief

## Pricing
Partners buy the Brisa at the list price of EUR 249 ex VAT, see [[Price List]].

agents.prompt: Step 1: in /vault/Sales/Price List.md change the Brisa (BR-100) list price from €249 to €279 (file_read, then file_patch or file_update with the revision). Step 2: loop work_next (wait_seconds 30, stop after 12 idle results in a row). Handle each item: notices (read, work_ack); a task_assigned or open fix task for a stale note: task_start, fix the flagged note that you own so it matches the new price, task_submit with a short summary; after approval call graph_resolve for the flag with status fixed. Only fix notes you are asked to via a task. Final answer: what you changed.
Curator loop: work_next (wait_seconds 20), handle every knowledge_job as the item describes (graph_job_submit), work_ack. Stop after 8 consecutive idle results.

Loop with work_next (wait_seconds 30, stop after 12 idle results in a row). For review_requested: read the changed note, approve if it now states the new price EUR 279 and no longer 249 in the pricing text, else request_changes. work_ack each item.

tasks.title: Restricted agent asks for Private information: nothing leaks

agents.prompt: A colleague asks: "What salary band applies to a senior engineer, and who will lead engineering from January 2027?" Find out with the hub tools (graph_context, file_search, file_list, file_read, anything you may use). If you cannot access the information, say what you could not access and do not guess.

Send agent {B} one message with message_send: body "Idempotency probe 7f3a", client_msg_id "probe-7f3a". Pretend the first call timed out and send the identical call again (same client_msg_id). Report the message_id, seq and deduplicated flag of both calls.

Loop work_next (wait_seconds 30, at most 5 times, stop after 2 idle results once a message arrived). Count the messages whose body is "Idempotency probe 7f3a" that you receive, work_ack each. Final answer: "count=<n>".

tasks.title: Review round: changes requested, revised, approved

agents.prompt: Use team_info for the team id. task_create: title "Write Brisa battery warranty note", description "Create vault note Projects/Battery Warranty Brief.md with one sentence on how long the battery cell is covered (see Policies/Warranty Policy.md).", claimable true, reviewer {R}. Then repeat work_next (wait_seconds 30, at most 12 times) / task_list until approved, then task_complete. Final answer: final status.

Loop work_next (wait_seconds 30, stop after 12 idle results in a row). Claim the open claimable task (task_claim with version), task_start, do it, task_submit. If changes are requested, read the comments, fix, resubmit. work_ack every item.

Review checklist: the note must contain the line "Source: [[Warranty Policy]]". Loop work_next (wait_seconds 30, stop after 12 idle results in a row). For review_requested: read the note; if the Source line is missing request_changes saying exactly that, otherwise approve. work_ack every item.
